text: The 2021 loss of 81.3 hectares (2.23% of the asset) is corroborated by multiple independent sources. The **Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13)** confirms the loss occurred in 2021, while the **JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 (V4)** shows 98% of the area was forested in 2020, meeting the 50% corroboration threshold. The **Uruguay Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries (MGAP) 2021 forest map** further details the affected area as planted forest (68.1 ha of *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), with no native forest involved. The analysis excludes smaller patches (<0.5 ha) to ensure reliability. All datasets agree on the event, and the asset remains fully covered by valid satellite data.
